guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails during the apt-get install step with errors indicating 'Unable to locate package python3.11' and related packages: python3.11-venv, python3.11-distutils. This is because Ubuntu 20.04 (focal) does not include Python 3.11 packages in its default repositories. To fix this, adjust the Dockerfile to either use Python 3.10 (which is included by default in Ubuntu 20.04) or add the necessary PPA (e.g., deadsnakes PPA) to install Python 3.11. For example, add these lines before installing python3.11: 'apt-get install -y software-properties-common && add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa && apt-get update'. Alternatively, consider switching the base image to Ubuntu 22.04, which includes Python 3.11 in default repos. Ensure all python3.11-related package installs in apt-get call are possible after this change. This fix will enable the Dockerfile to build successfully and provide the environment to run the tests.
